author: James Weldon Johnson
title: Fifty Years & Other Poems
edition: Boston: The Cornhill Company, 1917; dated title page. Only Johnson’s original English poems are selected. Prose line wraps are reflowed to spaces; paragraph boundaries and poetry line/stanza breaks are retained. Outer block whitespace, illustration markers, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted; original transcription punctuation and emphasis conventions are retained. Text follows the Project Gutenberg plain-text file, including its underscore emphasis and double-hyphen dash conventions.

rights.basis: This original English text/edition was published in 1917, before 1931, and its US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this transcription as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 17884 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Removed the PG header and footer, the title page, contents and Brander Matthews's introduction; kept the dedication, the acknowledgment and every poem in printed order, including the translations and the Jingles & Croons section and the closing italic envoi. Poem and section titles are level-2 headings (title and subtitle lines joined by line breaks); stanzas keep their lines with the block's outer whitespace trimmed and inner indentation kept; prose lines joined with single spaces.
